setup.title: From a Pencil Sketch to a Frame of Game: One Engineer Builds an NVIDIA GPU
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, realistic documentary look with warm practical lighting at home and cool industrial lighting in the fab.

cast.name: Lin
cast.description: Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, round tortoiseshell glasses and a small silver stud earring in each ear, wearing a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, black jeans and white sneakers.

extras.voice: Lin, a woman in her early thirties with a clear, warm alto voice, an energetic but relaxed pace and a neutral American accent (S1),
extras.music: Minimal electronic ambient score with a soft pulsing synth arpeggio and light percussion, kept at low volume beneath the narration throughout.
extras.speech: Lin narrates her own build in first person, like a maker video; inside the cleanroom she speaks through her face mask.

shots.prompt:
Inside a quiet home studio at midnight, a warm desk lamp casts a pool of soft amber light across a dark wooden work surface. Outside the focused glow, the room falls away into deep shadows, with the faint silhouettes of bookshelves and inactive computer monitors in the background. A ceramic coffee mug sits beside drafting pens, framing a closed, grid-lined notebook resting near the desk's edge. The atmosphere is calm, concentrated, and solitary, capturing the quiet stillness of an engineer's late-night workspace.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, wears round tortoiseshell glasses and small silver stud earrings. Dressed in a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, black jeans, and white sneakers, she pulls up an office chair and sits down. Reaching forward, she flips open the notebook to reveal a completely blank grid page under the lamplight. She picks up a mechanical pencil, clicks the top to advance the lead, and settles her hands beside the page. Looking directly into the camera, she speaks with calm confidence about her plan to build an NVIDIA GPU entirely from scratch.

The shot begins in an eye-level medium framing and performs a slow, steady push-in toward Lin and her desktop. Her upper torso, face, and deliberate hand movements remain in clear view throughout the push. The lamp's warm illumination keeps the pristine grid paper and her focused expression sharp, anchoring the scene as the dim room stays softly blurred.

annotation.beat: Night in Lin's small home studio. A warm desk lamp, a coffee mug and a blank grid notebook. Lin sits down, opens the notebook to an empty page, clicks a pencil and tells the camera she is going to build her own NVIDIA GPU from scratch.

state.outfit: moss-green zip hoodie over white T-shirt
state.gpu_stage: blank notebook page

shots.prompt:
The shot is set at a wooden work desk in Lin's compact home studio at night. An adjustable desk lamp casts a focused pool of warm amber light across an open grid notebook, highlighting the pale paper and leaving the rest of the room in soft, moody shadow. A ceramic coffee mug sits near the corner of the blotter. The setting conveys an intimate, quiet atmosphere dedicated to late-night technical design.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, wears round tortoiseshell glasses, small silver stud earrings, and a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, with her straight black hair gathered into a low ponytail. Holding a mechanical pencil over the initially blank page, she briskly draws out a GPU architecture. She sketches an organized grid of streaming multiprocessor blocks, runs a wide horizontal bar representing the L2 cache across the middle, and positions rectangular memory controllers along the outer edges. After scribbling neat labels beside the units, she lifts the pencil away from the finished graphite schematic and looks up, her face settling into a proud, satisfied smile.

The camera starts in a top-down close-up tightly framed on the notebook and her sketching hand. Once she finishes labeling the diagram, the camera tilts smoothly upward from the paper to her face. Lin remains centered as her warm expression comes into view, the desk lamp creating a gentle gleam on her glasses while the freshly completed block diagram stays anchored in the lower portion of the frame.

annotation.camera: top-down close-up then tilt up to her face
annotation.beat: Close on the notebook as Lin sketches the GPU architecture in pencil: a grid of streaming multiprocessor blocks, an L2 cache bar across the middle and memory controllers on the edges. She labels the blocks, then looks up satisfied.

state.outfit: moss-green zip hoodie over white T-shirt
state.gpu_stage: pencil block diagram of a GPU on paper

shots.prompt:
The interior of Lin's home studio centers on a wide cork board mounted on a neutral wall, densely layered with colorful sticky notes, printed silicon die photos, and technical diagrams. To the side, a tall window reveals the first faint cool-blue glow of early dawn, mingling softly with the warm amber light of an indoor desk lamp. The room feels still, calm, and steeped in the quiet concentration of an overnight engineering session.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, stands by the board with her shoulder-length straight black hair gathered into a low ponytail. She wears round tortoiseshell glasses, silver stud earrings, a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, black jeans, and white sneakers. Holding her open notebook, she carefully tears out the page containing the pencil sketch of the GPU architecture. She picks up a pushpin and anchors the newly freed sheet securely into the vacant center of the cork board, surrounded by the reference die photos. Once it is pinned flat, she lowers her hands and steps back slightly, her expression focused and satisfied.

The camera holds static in a medium-wide framing at eye level, keeping Lin’s upper body, the cork board, and the adjacent window all in view. The steady composition emphasizes her deliberate actions without moving, maintaining a clear visual focus on the newly pinned pencil architecture sheet as the subtle dawn light registers against the window pane.

annotation.beat: Lin tears the architecture page out of the notebook and pins it to the centre of a cork board covered with sticky notes and printed die photos. The first blue light of dawn appears in the window beside the board.

state.outfit: moss-green zip hoodie over white T-shirt
state.gpu_stage: architecture sketch pinned on the cork board

shots.prompt:
The home studio is filled with the calm, quiet ambience of early morning, illuminated by a mix of pale dawn filtering through a side window and warm domestic lighting overhead. A wide magnetic whiteboard mounted against the pale wall dominates the space, catching clean ambient light with minimal glare. The edges of nearby studio shelves and the home workstation remain softly visible in the background, framing an organized, intense workspace dedicated to technical design.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, has her shoulder-length straight black hair neatly gathered into a low ponytail. She wears round tortoiseshell glasses, small silver stud earrings, a moss-green zip hoodie over a clean white T-shirt, black jeans, and white sneakers. Holding a chisel-tip black dry-erase marker, she rapidly inks the final interconnections of an arithmetic unit circuit, detailing logic NAND gate symbols, inputs, and a square block representing a full adder. Once the lines connect, she clicks the cap onto the marker, turns slightly toward the lens, and taps the plastic cap directly against the full adder schematic. She speaks directly to the camera with animated confidence, explaining the logic flow and how these individual gates compute fundamental graphics math.

The camera maintains a medium framing at chest level, executing a steady, slow lateral track that glides horizontally alongside Lin as she shifts from sketching to speaking. The whiteboard schematic and her expressive gestures remain centered and sharp, keeping her face, hands, and the newly drafted circuit diagram simultaneously in view throughout the shot.

annotation.beat: At a large whiteboard Lin draws a transistor-level circuit for one arithmetic unit with a black marker: NAND gates, a full adder and wires. She taps the adder with the marker cap and explains it to the camera.

state.outfit: moss-green zip hoodie over white T-shirt
state.gpu_stage: circuit schematic on the whiteboard

shots.prompt:
The home studio desk is bathed in warm practical light from an adjustable lamp, contrasted against the vivid luminescence of two dual monitors. Soft ambient light fills the quiet room, casting gentle shadows across the wooden desktop. A mousepad, ergonomic keyboard, and Lin's open paper notebook sit beside the displays. The atmosphere feels focused and authentic, capturing the meticulous reality of modern microchip design.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length straight black hair in a low ponytail, sits upright at the workstation. She wears round tortoiseshell glasses, small silver stud earrings, a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, black jeans, and white sneakers. Resting her hand on the mouse, she scrolls smoothly to manipulate the chip layout software. On the main screen, tightly packed rectangles of microscopic metal interconnects in cyan, red, and gold begin to contract. As she zooms out, the microscopic traces resolve into an entire glowing silicon die floorplan, forming a dense mosaic of processing cores and memory arrays that visually echoes her paper sketch. She watches intently as the complete layout fills the display.

The camera starts in an over-the-shoulder framing, keeping Lin's hooded shoulder and hand on the mouse in view, before gliding slowly forward into a crisp close-up of the primary monitor. The shot finishes tight on the vibrant, luminous architecture of the completed die layout, keeping every dense circuit block distinct and razor-sharp.

annotation.beat: Lin works at two monitors running chip layout software. Colourful rectangles of metal layers fill the screen; she zooms out until the whole die floorplan appears as a dense, glowing mosaic that matches her paper sketch.

state.outfit: moss-green zip hoodie over white T-shirt
state.gpu_stage: full die layout on the monitor

shots.prompt:
The interior entryway beside the front door of Lin's home studio is bathed in warm practical morning light. Neutral walls, a minimalist coat rack, and a small wooden console table create an orderly, lived-in domestic space. Outside the entryway, vibrant morning sun awaits, casting a bright sliver along the edge of the doorframe. The mood is quiet and focused, capturing the purposeful routine of an early departure.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, has shoulder-length straight black hair in a low ponytail, round tortoiseshell glasses, and small silver stud earrings. She begins dressed in a moss-green zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, with black jeans and white sneakers. Taking a medium-blue denim jacket, she slips her arms into the sleeves, settling it over the hoodie. She then picks up a tightly rolled paper printout of the die layout from the console, slides it into a rigid black poster tube, caps it, and slings the strap across her shoulder. Fully prepared with the denim jacket over her hoodie and the tube resting securely against her torso, she turns the door handle and pushes the door open into the intense morning glare.

The camera tracks alongside Lin in a steady medium shot, moving smoothly as she steps toward the exit. Eye-level framing keeps her upper body, the jacket adjustment, and the handling of the poster tube clearly in view. When the door swings open, the camera maintains focus as bright exterior daylight washes across her, framing her poised exit in a realistic, unembellished documentary manner.

annotation.camera: medium shot following her to the door
annotation.beat: Morning. Lin pulls a denim jacket on over her hoodie, slides a rolled printout of the layout into a black poster tube, slings it over her shoulder and opens the front door into bright daylight.

shots.prompt:
The wide concrete plaza outside the semiconductor fabrication plant sits bathed in the crisp, pale gold light of early morning. Looming ahead, the monumental facility features a sleek glass-and-steel facade that mirrors the clear blue sky, accented by clean architectural lines and brushed metal paneling. Long, sharp morning shadows stretch across the light-grey pavers of the walkway. Near the building's entrance, polished turnstiles and glass security barriers establish an orderly, high-tech industrial atmosphere.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties with straight black hair tied in a low ponytail, walks briskly across the plaza. She wears round tortoiseshell glasses, small silver stud earrings, a denim jacket over a moss-green zip hoodie, a white T-shirt, black jeans, and white sneakers. Slung diagonally across her shoulder is a black poster tube containing the rolled layout printout. With purposeful steps, she approaches the entrance gate, lifts a keycard badge clipped to her jacket, and taps it against the scanner terminal. The reader beeps softly with a green flash, and she smoothly pushes through the waist-high barrier, keeping her stride steady.

The camera tracks smoothly in a wide shot, moving alongside Lin to capture her full figure against the imposing scale of the fab. The framing maintains a clean view of her approach and badge tap, with the towering glass building and sunny plaza remaining prominent throughout. The crisp morning sunlight cleanly outlines her movement, lending a grounded documentary clarity to her arrival.

annotation.beat: Lin walks across a plaza toward a huge modern semiconductor fab with a glass-and-steel facade under a clear morning sky, poster tube on her shoulder, and taps her badge at the entrance gate.

shots.prompt:
The brightly lit semiconductor fab gowning room is lined with stainless steel benches, sealed lockers, and glossy, seamless white wall panels. Recessed overhead LED panels cast a cool, uniform illumination across the pristine floor, creating a sterile, tightly regulated industrial atmosphere devoid of dust or clutter.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties with round tortoiseshell glasses, small silver stud earrings, and shoulder-length black hair tied in a low ponytail, stands beside a bench where her black poster tube rests. Wearing her denim jacket over a moss-green hoodie, she steps into a white cleanroom coverall. She pulls the protective fabric up over her shoulders, smoothly pulls the zipper closed to her chin, and draws the tight white hood over her head, tucking away her ponytail and ears. She then hooks an elastic white face mask over her nose and mouth before sliding clear safety goggles directly over her tortoiseshell glasses. By the end of the shot, Lin is completely enclosed in the full white bunny suit, leaving only her focused eyes and glasses visible behind the clear visor.

The camera holds a static medium shot at chest level, capturing Lin’s methodical gowning sequence without panning or tilting. The cleanroom background and steel bench remain steadily in frame as the cool lighting highlights the crisp white fabric, keeping her precise routine as the clear central focus.

annotation.beat: In a bright white gowning room with steel benches, Lin steps into a white cleanroom coverall, zips it up, pulls on the white hood, a white face mask and clear safety goggles over her glasses. Only her eyes and glasses remain visible.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: none in hand

shots.prompt:
The narrow air shower chamber features brushed stainless-steel walls studded with circular high-velocity nozzles. Cool industrial fluorescent lighting reflects sharply off the polished metal surfaces and the clear glass doors enclosing the space. Overhead, a small status panel provides a clean, clinical glow. The atmosphere is stark, sterile, and pressurized, conveying the extreme cleanliness standards required before entering the semiconductor fabrication floor.

Lin stands inside, completely sealed in a white cleanroom bunny suit with an integrated hood, white face mask, and clear safety goggles. Beneath the goggles, her round tortoiseshell glasses and focused dark eyes are visible, while her black hair is fully tucked away. Her hands are empty in white cleanroom gloves. She holds her arms slightly raised as strong jets of air blast from the nozzles, violently rippling the fabric of her coverall. She turns slightly in place to catch the airflow across her torso. After several seconds, the buffeting air stops, and the suit settles. A small indicator light shifts to green, and the inner door smoothly slides open to the side.

The camera remains stationary in a medium shot, viewing Lin through the transparent glass door at eye level. The framing captures her from the waist up, keeping her centered amidst the metallic walls. Her steady stance, the rippling fabric, and the green signal light stay clearly in focus, while faint ambient reflections on the glass accentuate the sealed, clinical environment.

annotation.camera: static medium shot through the glass door
annotation.beat: Lin, fully suited in white, stands inside a narrow stainless-steel air shower with her arms raised while strong jets of air ripple the fabric of her suit. A green light turns on and the inner door slides open.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: none in hand

shots.prompt:
The photolithography bay unfolds as a vast, pristine cleanroom bathed in saturated amber-yellow safety lighting. Massive white lithography scanner systems line the polished floor panels, their towering enclosures accented with stainless-steel trim and glowing status indicators. Filtered air grates in the ceiling and perforated floor tiles maintain continuous laminar airflow, creating an ultra-sterile, precisely controlled industrial atmosphere where every surface gleams under the monochromatic yellow wash.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, is clad from head to toe in a white cleanroom bunny suit with an integrated hood, a white face mask, and clear protective goggles through which her round tortoiseshell glasses remain visible. She walks steadily forward carrying a specialized transparent reticle pod that houses the patterned glass photomask of her GPU design. Moving with deliberate care, she approaches the automated interface port on the front of a lithography machine. She gently positions the clear pod onto the receiving dock and guides it forward until the mechanical port clamps firmly engage, transferring the photomask into the scanner's internal mechanism. By the end of the action, her gloved hands pull back, resting empty at her sides.

The camera executes a slow dolly forward, starting in a medium-wide framing that tracks Lin walking down the amber-lit aisle before tightening as she interfaces with the machine. The framing stays smooth and level at chest height, maintaining clear view of Lin's precise hand movements and the reticle port throughout the loading sequence.

annotation.beat: Lin walks into the photolithography bay, a long cleanroom bathed in amber-yellow light with tall white lithography machines. She carries a clear pod holding the photomask made from her design and loads it into a reticle port.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: photomask of her design loaded into the scanner

shots.prompt:
Inside the photolithography bay of the advanced fabrication facility, monochromatic amber-yellow safety lighting bathes the cleanroom to shield photoresists from unintended ultraviolet exposure. Pristine white equipment enclosures, brushed stainless steel automated fixtures, and the open port of a front-opening unified pod create a sterile, high-precision industrial environment. Laminar airflow and climate-controlled filtration maintain an atmosphere of hushed, immaculate stillness.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, stands beside the load port. She is entirely enclosed in a white cleanroom bunny suit with its hood drawn tight, wearing a white protective face mask and clear safety goggles over her round tortoiseshell glasses, with only her dark, focused eyes exposed. A precision robotic arm engages, carefully sliding under and lifting a blank, circular 300-millimetre silicon wafer from the pod's interior racks. As the disc rises, Lin leans slightly forward to observe the process. The pristine, mirror-polished surface of the wafer catches the warm amber overhead lighting and casts back a clear reflection of Lin's masked, goggled face watching the flawless silicon ready for printing.

The camera frames a close-up starting on the mechanical gripper holding the wafer's edge, then performs a slow, fluid tilt upward as the robotic arm elevates the disc. The camera movement maintains razor-sharp focus on the gleaming reflective surface, keeping both the amber reflections and Lin's watchful eyes visible throughout the steady motion.

annotation.beat: A robotic arm lifts a blank, mirror-polished 300 millimetre silicon wafer out of a front-opening pod. The wafer reflects the amber light and Lin's goggled face as she leans in to watch.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: blank mirror-polished silicon wafer

shots.prompt:
The lithography track inside the cleanroom glows under amber safety lighting mixed with sterile LED illumination from within the coater chamber. Viewed through the thick observation window, the stainless-steel spin module appears impeccably sterile, isolated from airborne contaminants. The environment conveys intense industrial precision and quiet, automated control.

Lin stands beside the viewport, dressed in a white cleanroom bunny suit with its hood pulled up, wearing protective goggles over her round tortoiseshell glasses, a surgical face mask, and white nitrile gloves. At first, a blank, mirror-polished 300-millimetre silicon wafer rests on the vacuum chuck. An automated nozzle dispenses a droplet of liquid photoresist directly onto the centre. The chuck accelerates into a high-speed spin, flinging the liquid outward into an ultra-thin film that flashes with brilliant iridescent rings of violet, cyan, and gold before settling into a uniform, coated surface. Lin observes intently, her gloved hand resting against the machine casing as her focused eyes follow the rapid fluid motion.

The camera frames a tight close-up through the viewport glass, maintaining crisp focus on the spinning wafer while Lin's masked profile and goggles reflect softly in the transparent pane. The camera holds nearly stationary with a minute drift inward, keeping the vibrant rainbow interference patterns and smooth rotation fully visible.

annotation.beat: Inside a coater, a drop of photoresist lands on the wafer and the wafer spins fast, the liquid spreading into a thin film that flashes with iridescent colours. Lin watches through the window with her gloved hand on the panel.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: wafer coated with photoresist

shots.prompt:
The lithography bay of the semiconductor fabrication facility is bathed in amber cleanroom lighting, preserving photoresist integrity. Matte-white tool enclosures and stainless steel panels line the sterile corridor. Inside the lithography scanner, a rhythmic pulse of deep violet light flashes intermittently through an inspection seam, cast by the laser exposure source as the high-speed stage steps across hundreds of fields. Clean laminar airflow generates a quiet, continuous hum throughout the pristine, high-tech environment.

Lin stands beside the operator console, completely suited in a white cleanroom bunny suit with a hood, white face mask, and clear goggles over her round tortoiseshell glasses. Her gloved hands rest on the desk edge as she monitors the automated process. On the primary screen, a graphical map of the circular wafer populates field by field, filling each square die location as the UV beam imprints the GPU circuitry onto the coated surface. Lin watches the display with focused concentration, occasionally shifting her gaze toward the machine's viewport as the violet pulses count down the stepping exposure.

The camera starts in a medium shot showing Lin in three-quarter profile alongside the workstation, slowly pushing in toward the illuminated monitors. Lin’s suited torso, the subtle violet flicker reflecting against the cleanroom panels, and the expanding grid on the wafer map remain visible throughout the move.

annotation.camera: medium shot, slow push toward the monitors
annotation.beat: Lin stands at the lithography scanner's control monitors. A pulsing violet glow comes from inside the machine as the wafer stage steps across hundreds of fields; on screen a progress map of the wafer fills in field by field.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: wafer being exposed with her pattern

shots.prompt:
Inside the fab's etch bay, clean and sterile white overhead illumination bounces off brushed stainless steel surfaces and high-grade composite panels. The expansive cleanroom aisle is anchored by modular plasma processing tools interconnected by vacuum lines and specialized gas manifolds. Set into the front of a primary reaction chamber, a thick circular quartz viewport offers a direct view inside, where an electric magenta-purple glow of ionized plasma hums with concentrated energy, casting vivid violet reflections across the surrounding metallic chassis as the wafer undergoes dry etching.

Lin stands adjacent to the etch chamber, dressed in a full white cleanroom bunny suit complete with an integrated hood, sterile white face mask, and clear protective goggles fitted over her round tortoiseshell glasses. Her gloved hands hold a slender, chemical-resistant white tablet displaying real-time pressure curves and radio-frequency power metrics. She tracks the telemetry data with steady eyes, lightly tapping the screen with a gloved finger to log the current process cycle. She then raises her gaze to observe the glowing viewport, checking the uniformity of the violet plasma enveloping the wafer within the vacuum.

The shot begins in a tight close-up on the circular viewport, filling the frame with the swirling, vibrant magenta-purple plasma glow. The camera then smoothly pulls back along a straight diagonal axis, steadily revealing the massive cylindrical chamber and Lin beside it. The final composition settles into a medium shot that holds Lin, her active tablet, and the intensely glowing viewport in balanced, sharp view.

annotation.camera: close-up on a viewport then pull back to Lin
annotation.beat: In a white-lit bay of etch tools, a magenta-purple plasma glows through the round viewport of a vacuum chamber as the pattern is etched into the wafer. The camera pulls back to Lin, suited in white, checking a tablet.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: wafer in the etch chamber

shots.prompt:
The high-tech semiconductor fab etch bay glows under sterile, cool white cleanroom illumination filtered through pristine overhead panels. In the softly blurred background, stainless steel vacuum chambers, robotic transfer modules, and neat rows of metallic ductwork maintain an immaculate, ultra-pure industrial atmosphere. Reflections gleam across polished chrome fixtures and glossy floor panels, creating a crisp environment of absolute precision and quiet technological marvel.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, is clad in a pristine white cleanroom bunny suit with the hood tightly pulled over her hair, a pleated white face mask, and clear protective goggles sitting over her round tortoiseshell glasses. With both hands clad in pale cleanroom gloves, she steadily holds up a specialized wafer handling tool grasping a finished circular silicon disk. As Lin gently tilts the wafer under the overhead illumination, its mirror-like surface reveals a dense, immaculate grid of hundreds of microscopic rectangular dies. The microscopic circuitry acts as a diffraction grating, scattering the light into vivid bands of iridescent rainbow hues that shimmer across the silicon. Above her mask, her dark eyes crinkle into an unmistakable, proud smile.

The camera frames Lin and the suspended disk in a medium close-up, executing a slow, continuous orbit from front to three-quarter profile. This gentle rotational move accentuates the shifting chromatic spectrum flaring across the wafer's grid while keeping Lin's expressive eyes and steady gloved posture clearly visible. The sterile machinery of the bay remains softly diffused behind her, highlighting the glittering centerpiece of completed silicon.

annotation.beat: Lin holds the finished wafer up in a gloved wafer holder. Its surface is now a precise grid of hundreds of identical rectangular dies that split the light into rainbow colours as she tilts it. Her eyes smile above the mask.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: patterned wafer with a rainbow grid of dies

shots.prompt:
Inside the fab test floor, clean industrial overhead lights cast an immaculate, cool white glow across rows of specialized automated testing equipment. The atmosphere is quiet and clinical, defined by the low hum of mechanical drive stages and continuous HEPA air filtration. At the center of the station sits a high-precision wafer prober, its vacuum chuck holding the circular silicon disc beneath an intricate stereo microscope assembly, accompanied by diagnostic test screens displaying technical readouts in the background.

Lin, an East Asian woman in her early thirties, is completely clad in a sterile white cleanroom bunny suit with an integrated hood, protective clear goggles fitted over her round tortoiseshell glasses, and a white face mask. Leaning forward over the equipment, she peers into the binocular microscope eyepieces. Below, the patterned wafer rests on the motorized chuck as the microscopic needles of a probe card descend with micrometer precision, making physical contact with the tiny pads of an individual die. Lin delicately adjusts the stage controls with gloved fingers, maintaining focus while the probe system runs electrical tests before automatically indexing to the next die on the wafer grid.

The shot begins in a sharp close-up on the fine probe needles touching down upon the iridescent die surface, capturing the minute mechanical contact. The camera then smoothly glides back and tilts up into a stable medium shot, keeping Lin's suited posture, the microscope optics, and the stepping probe chuck continuously visible within the coolly lit cleanroom interior.

annotation.camera: close-up of the probe card then medium shot
annotation.beat: On the test floor the wafer sits on a probe station chuck. Fine needles of a probe card touch down on one die after another while Lin, still suited, leans over the microscope eyepiece.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: patterned wafer under probe test

shots.prompt:
The cleanroom test floor is bathed in cool, neutral white lighting, casting a crisp and sterile atmosphere across the workstation. An industrial monitor displays a circular wafer yield map composed of a fine grid. As the automated test concludes, the grid squares rapidly populate with bright green across the entire center, dotted with only a few isolated red squares near the outer perimeter. Cleanroom wall panels and equipment consoles reflect the monitor's glow, centering the vivid yield graphic in the quiet, clinical space.

Lin is dressed in a full white cleanroom bunny suit with the hood tightly enclosing her hair, a pleated surgical mask over her lower face, and protective goggles over her round tortoiseshell glasses. She wears pale blue nitrile gloves. Initially turned toward the screen, she watches the final rows of the wafer map resolve into solid green. As the successful readout completes, Lin pivots her upper body toward the camera. Her dark eyes crinkle with unmistakable joy behind her lenses, smiling broadly beneath her mask. She raises her gloved right hand and flashes a firm, enthusiastic thumbs-up to celebrate the high yield. Her cleanroom suit remains spotless throughout.

The camera holds an over-the-shoulder medium shot at eye level, keeping the monitor screen and Lin’s suited torso in crisp focus. A gentle static frame accommodates Lin's pivot without panning away, allowing her celebratory gesture, expressive masked face, and the bright green wafer map behind her to remain clearly visible together until the shot ends.

annotation.beat: A monitor shows a circular wafer map filling with mostly green squares and a few red ones at the edge. Lin turns from the screen to the camera and gives a big thumbs-up with her gloved hand.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: tested wafer with a mostly green yield map

shots.prompt:
Inside the semiconductor fab's dicing bay, cool blue-white industrial lighting illuminates the sterile workspace and the sealed interior of an automated dicing saw. The pristine chamber is framed by stainless steel fixtures and a clear protective observation window. Fine jets of deionized coolant continuously spray across the cutting stage, scattering glistening micro-droplets against interior surfaces and catching brilliant, sharp reflections from high-intensity internal LEDs. The atmosphere is clinical, quiet, and rigorously controlled.

Positioned just behind the transparent viewing window, Lin monitors the automated operation. She is clad in full cleanroom gear: a white zippered bunny suit with its hood drawn tight, a white face mask over her nose and mouth, and clear safety goggles resting over her round tortoiseshell glasses. Inside the machine, an ultra-thin diamond saw blade spins at high speed, tracing along microscopic streets between circuits on the silicon wafer. Cooled by the fine water spray, the blade cuts smooth, straight lines through the grid, steadily separating the patterned disc into individual rectangular dies. Lin leans forward slightly, her dark eyes behind the goggles watching every motorized pass with steady focus.

The camera maintains a macro close-up framed on the spinning blade and the water-slicked silicon surface, with Lin’s suited silhouette and masked face visible in soft focus through the chamber window in the upper background. A subtle sideways tracking movement follows the cutting axis, keeping the blade, the fine water mist, and the newly separated dies in sharp view throughout.

annotation.beat: A thin diamond saw blade spins inside a dicing machine and cuts straight lines through the wafer under a fine spray of water, separating the grid into individual dies. Lin watches from behind the machine's window.

state.outfit: white cleanroom bunny suit with hood, face mask and goggles
state.gpu_stage: wafer being diced into dies

shots.prompt:
The cleanroom dicing station is bathed in cool, sterile overhead fluorescent light, complemented by the intense, direct white glow of an articulated magnifier ring lamp. On the clean stainless-steel workbench, a freshly diced wafer rests stretched across vibrant blue dicing tape held rigid inside a circular metal frame. The atmosphere is quiet, pristine, and clinically controlled, filled with the faint, steady white noise of laminar air filtration.

Lin stands beside the station, completely suited in a white cleanroom bunny suit with the hood enclosing her hair, protective goggles resting over her round tortoiseshell glasses, and a pleated sterile face mask covering her nose and mouth.
